lambda0 = 6.0, // AA] Source wavelength (Angstrom)

r2 = 0.0035, // m] Sample aperture radius / half-width (m)

 filename = "detector_2d.dat", xwidth = 0.6,
 yheight = 0.6, restore_neutron = 1)
